About.title: About me
About.content: I'm a developer with experience in TypeScript and C#. I build commercial websites, Discord bots and web applications, including NortBot and its ecosystem. I also take on freelance projects for individual clients.

lode.title: Lode
lode.content: Lode is a simple home hub for movies and shows: find a title, pick the best version, and download it with one click, then watch it in Jellyfin. No complicated setup, more media servers on the way.

nortbot.title: NortBot
nortbot.content: One bot to run your whole Discord server: moderation, economy, polls, 4FUN commands and handy utilities that keep your community safe, active and entertained.

englishflow.title: English Flow - Language School
englishflow.content: A polished bilingual website for an English language school that turns visitors into students, with a streamlined contact form and SEO that helps new students find it.

spears.title: Spears
spears.content: A fast, addictive tap-timing game: hurl spears at a spinning wheel, dodge every stuck spear, and climb through escalating levels. Easy to learn, hard to put down.

badmintonMatch.title: Badminton Match
badmintonMatch.content: Your courtside companion for badminton: live scoring, player profiles, full match history, and spoken point summaries in English, Polish, and German.

mystiqo.title: Mystiqo
mystiqo.content: Meet strangers for anonymous real-time chats that are private by design, fast by default, and always one click from a new conversation.

northook.title: NortHook
northook.content: Discord webhooks without the friction: compose, live-preview, and fire messages in seconds. The fastest way to wire Discord into anything you build.
